title: Range expansion of program gates
statement: Let $m,w,n,L,a\in\mathbb{N}$, let $F$ assign a bit string to each element of a finite type, let $z$ be a bit string, and let $f$ assign a gate instruction to each natural number. The gates produced by the tabulated program starting at $a$ from the list of instructions $f(a),\ldots,f(a+L-1)$ are the concatenation, in increasing index order, of the gates produced separately by each instruction at its corresponding index.
hypotheses_covered: A finite type of instruction kinds
A function $F$ from kinds to bit strings
A function $f$ from natural numbers to gate instructions
